How Swerve Strickland connects

  • Faction: House of Black — House of Black feuded through Swerve's rise.

What is Swerve Strickland?

Swerve Strickland moved from Mogul Embassy / Mogul Affiliates into a main-event run, winning the AEW World Championship and feuding through House of Black and Hangman Page programs.

Key threads lead to AEW World Championship and House of Black.
